protocol: Short Jetson CPU deployment cost study with32 unique indoor pairs per run; four policies/three detectors. Measured named rail integrals; no FLIR accuracy labels. Warmup excluded. No inference on Jetson GPU for additional families.
limitations: Single short trial per case: percentiles are exploratory and not stable tail estimates.
Shared host: dashboard and camera acquisition remain active; named-rail energy includes all background activity, not isolated model or wall-plug energy.
CPU results must not be pooled with earlier YOLO TensorRT GPU study.
1s budget applies to this CPU pilot only; workstation study uses25ms.
No continuous live-video, cross-environment, or additional-family TensorRT claims.
